author: pwt19845
quote: I'll start by saying that the game is graphically amazing and the level of detail is impressive; however, in my opinion, this is not GTA. I understand that some studios will copy/ apply mechanics from their previous games and apply them to a new game. That's not the issue here. Here, it feels like RDR2 with a GTA coat of paint. I love the GTA and RDR games but for two separate reasons. I like GTA for the sheer amount of trouble/chaos you can cause, and the hilarious, ridiculous, and over-the-top stories they tell. I like RDR2 for its world-building, scope, and the cinematic tales that are told. They make you care for each person you interact with. This GTA seems to force everything that made RDR2 great into it, while completely stripping away what makes GTA great.  This is not the GTA I was hoping for.
